crossRefs.note: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

people.name: Adoni-bezek
people.line: Canaanite king captured and mutilated by Judah

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Perizzites
people.line: Canaanite people group living in the land of Canaan

translations.web: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
translations.bsb: And there they found Adoni-bezek and fought against him, striking down the Canaanites and Perizzites.
translations.kjv: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
translations.asv: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek; and they fought against him, and they smote the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
